premises.text: Industrial robotic arms are too expensive, hard to use, and insufficiently safe for broader use
premises.evidence_span: The problem is that they're expensive, they're difficult to use, and quite frankly, not that safe

premises.text: Casio delivers industrial-arm capability at roughly laptop price (about 10x cheaper)
premises.evidence_span: Casio has the capabilities of an industrial arm, but the price of a laptop. That's 10 times cheaper

premises.text: The arm moves >1 kg within a 1 m envelope with sub-millimeter precision on a carbon-fiber, brushless design
premises.evidence_span: Cassia can move over one kilogram anywhere within a one-meter work envelope with sub-millimeter precision

premises.text: Swappable end attachments turn the arm into different tools, including user-made ones
premises.evidence_span: You can transform Casio into a completely different tool just by swapping the attachments at the end

premises.text: Users train motions by guiding the arm or via app/Leap Motion without special skills
premises.evidence_span: Simply guide the arm through a motion that it plays back perfectly. For something more complex, you can use our app or other devices like a Leap Motion or Connect. So importantly, you don't need any special skills to get started

premises.text: Full-surface proximity sensing detects humans up to 20 inches from any point on the arm
premises.evidence_span: It can detect a human up to 20 inches away in any direction from any point on the arm

premises.text: A developer platform with APIs lets people who can build websites code for Cassia
premises.evidence_span: we've made Cassia a developer platform. Our APIs cut the complexity, so if you can build a website, you can code for Cassia

value.text: Robotic arms become as ubiquitous as computers for many applications
value.evidence_span: to make robotic arms as ubiquitous as computers
